# RenovoRx Appoints Interventional Oncology Medtech Leader Richard Stark to its Board of Directors


November 19, 2026 8:30am EST


MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[RenovoRx, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=SVnvwfbpc-Y4XyjOu06hE5niIpJL6kiO5rhIbcz6kt-4iCHXLQC7Egy_gPODpbEiUFAElnXnHByrRSCT_ZixWHFeAXoAv7iE9_t3yrxRHx4hGLgfUhbtHbSgxvEUIyuZbWczAAvQaMlcCP2N9SYv3OhhWtoCLRB_QR2Keihj9xnwfxdA6C5ozDtgIZRHNlBX4mwUL8MRlDCNFhV9-tXdxuxHyIONTvhHYUsYk8w_sNBkBhUATU9-T3F36q2DTj1ADkPhhCZL0Z_4ghve9OsQix0f9pT2DYKcz_lHfFFq4HyS1a3N9Q-vhhrva6o9J1nSJ_lfTGuO1lebmMlCZdtEPuCFUWO8UXMi-96DsUB0G2OUF2CXdx019PWeSR1p4j8F2N1N338JyLLjIvtKxwMH_I7FHSXeUAs3LsovmuE_7PlpKBAiVQ6a3iLjQiDZjRhW) **(“RenovoRx” or “the Company”) (Nasdaq: RNXT)** , a life sciences company commercializing **RenovoCath** **®** , a patented, FDA-cleared drug-delivery device, and evaluating a novel targeted oncology drug-device product candidate, today announced the appointment of Richard A. Stark, Chief Executive Officer of Innoblative Designs, Inc., to the Company’s Board of Directors.


Mr. Stark brings more than three decades of leadership experience in medical technology to the RenovoRx Board, with a focus on setting and executing commercialization strategies of interventional oncology medical technologies. He has advised RenovoRx since late 2024, helping its commercial team lay the foundation for the Company’s commercial efforts. He now brings his expertise and knowledge of the RenovoRx’s **TAMP™ (Trans-Arterial Micro-Perfusion) platform, enabled by RenovoCath** , to the Company’s Board as RenovoRx continues to gain traction in the market and physician adoption across U.S. cancer centers.


“We are pleased to welcome Rick to our Board of Directors,” said Shaun Bagai, Chief Executive Officer of RenovoRx. “Beyond his decades of experience in medtech sales and marketing, Rick has been instrumental in building the infrastructure that is accelerating physician adoption of RenovoCath in interventional oncology, and his insight sharpened our commercial approach at a critical juncture. As our market penetration across cancer centers deepens, his boardroom perspective will be important in continuing to shape our commercial strategy and guiding how we scale.”


Mr. Stark currently serves as Chief Executive Officer of Innoblative Designs, Inc., a medical technology company developing an RFA electrosurgical platform for intraoperative soft-tissue coagulation and ablation, including development programs in breast-conserving surgery. He is also Founder and Principal of RAS Consulting Firm, LLC, which advises medical technology companies on commercialization strategy, and Founder and Managing Member of MedTech Angels, a physician and executive-led angel investment group focused on medical technology. He serves as an independent director of Pleural Dynamics and Polyembo.


“I have spent my career working with oncologists and other physicians to adopt technologies that deliver therapy with greater precision, and I believe RenovoRx is well positioned with RenovoCath at the intersection of innovation and patient impact,” said Mr. Stark. “Having worked as an advisor to the commercial team for nearly two years, I have seen the TAMP platform’s strength firsthand, and I am excited to continue to contribute my experience as a Board member as the Company builds on its innovative approach to targeted therapeutic delivery for patients with difficult-to-treat solid tumors.”


**About RenovoCath**


Based on its FDA clearance, RenovoCath® is intended for the isolation of blood flow and delivery of fluids, including diagnostic and/or therapeutic agents, to select sites in the peripheral vascular system. RenovoCath is also indicated for temporary vessel occlusion in applications including arteriography, preoperative occlusion, and chemotherapeutic drug infusion. **About RenovoRx, Inc.**


**RenovoRx, Inc. (Nasdaq: RNXT)** is a life sciences company commercializing RenovoCath®, a novel, FDA-cleared device for local drug delivery designed to address significant unmet medical needs, with a focus on difficult-to-treat tumors. The Company is also evaluating intra-arterial gemcitabine (IAG) delivered via RenovoCath using RenovoRx’s **Trans-Arterial Micro-Perfusion (TAMP™)** platform as a novel drug-device product candidate for locally advanced pancreatic cancer.


RenovoRx’s patented TAMP™ platform is designed for targeted therapeutic delivery across the arterial wall near the tumor site to bathe the target tumor, potentially improving safety, tolerance, and efficacy while minimizing the toxicities associated with systemic intravenous therapy. The Company's mission is to transform the lives of cancer patients by providing innovative solutions to enable targeted delivery of diagnostic and therapeutic agents.


RenovoRx completed enrollment in the Phase III TIGeR-PaC clinical trial in August 2026, and anticipates the initial topline data in the second half of 2027. The trial is evaluating its novel drug-device combination oncology product candidate intra-arterial gemcitabine delivered via RenovoCath (IAG). RenovoCath enables IAG, and is FDA-cleared for temporary vessel occlusion in applications including arteriography, preoperative occlusion, and chemotherapeutic drug infusion. IAG is currently under investigation and has not been approved for commercial sale.


RenovoCath with gemcitabine received Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) for pancreatic cancer and bile duct cancer, and oxaliplatin has received ODD for pancreatic cancer, each of which provides seven years of market exclusivity upon new drug application approval by the FDA.
